integrity: The claim is stated only at the level proved. Literature searches did not reveal the same finite-chain classification, but exhaustive absence from all literature is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to finite chains and uses totality essentially.
No enumeration is claimed for arbitrary finite lattices or for K-algebras without the T axioms.
Finite computation is corroborative only; the factorial formula is proved structurally.
title: Factorial classification of preconditionals on finite chains
